# UI documentation

## UI stack facts

- The app module enables Jetpack Compose in `buildFeatures`.
- Navigation uses `androidx.navigation.compose.composable` routes inside `NavigationBuilder.kt`.
- There is no standalone stations screen: Zemer Stations render on the Home content tab `HomeContentTab.RADIO` (`ui/screens/HomeContentTab.kt`, cards from `ui/component/ZemerStationCard.kt`).

<!-- generated:ui-stack-facts - regenerated by docs/generate.py; edit the generator, not this block -->

- UI source is under `app/src/main/kotlin/com/jtech/zemer/ui` (242 tracked Kotlin files).
- The package directories are `component`, `component/lyrics`, `component/shimmer`, `menu`, `player`, `screens`, `screens/artist`, `screens/library`, `screens/onboarding`, `screens/playlist`, `screens/podcast`, `screens/recognition`, `screens/search`, `screens/settings`, `screens/statuses`, `theme`, `utils`.
- `Screens.MainScreens` is `Home`, `Artists`, `Podcasts`, `KidZone`, `Search`, `Library` (`ui/screens/Screens.kt`). `Screens.PinnedTopBarRoutes` is the `artists`, `podcasts` and `kid_zone` routes.

<!-- /generated:ui-stack-facts -->
